item.title: Geely PH May Have Just Broken Into The Top 5 In New Car Sales Last September
item.description: Geely Motor Philippines (GMP) reached a sales milestone last September. Last month, it has sold 1,023 vehicles—the first time it has crossed the 1,000-unit mark in a single month. Read More »

item.title: VinFast projects P413K savings with MPV 7
